product_family: K-12 formative assessment and gamified learning platform (Quizizz, rebranded to Wayground in 2025) with related sub-products: Wayground for Business (corporate training), Skillet (AI sales roleplay/coaching, skillet.io), and Voyage Math (math practice, voyagemath.com).

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No SOC 2 badge, report, or descriptive certification text was found on any wayground.com privacy/security/help page. A Drata-powered Trust Center exists at trust.quizizz.com, but it is access-gated (returns HTTP 403) and requires a request to view. No public vendor-domain proof of a completed SOC 2 report exists.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Wayground is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified. This certification demonstrates our adherence to international standards for information security management, ensuring that we have robust policies, procedures, and controls in place to manage risks and safeguard your data.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: We are committed to complying with GDPR, ensuring that your personal data is processed securely and in accordance with these regulations.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. HIPAA is not mentioned on the privacy policy, privacy center, or help center pages. The product is a K-12 education tool and is not marketed or positioned as a HIPAA covered entity or business associate.

certifications.name: COPPA
certifications.proof_quote: We comply with FERPA and COPPA and will work with your organization to meet relevant state and regional privacy commitments.

certifications.name: FERPA
certifications.proof_quote: We comply with FERPA and COPPA and will work with your organization to meet relevant state and regional privacy commitments.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Financial transactions are processed via a PCI-compliant payment provider. This is the third-party payment processor's certification, not a PCI DSS certification held by Quizizz Inc. / Wayground itself.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not mentioned on any wayground.com or help.wayground.com page despite significant AI-feature marketing (Wayground AI, AI Question Generator, AI Presentation Maker, etc.).

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on any vendor-domain page.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; product is not marketed for U.S. federal government use.

privacy.ai_training_note: Wayground states it has disabled use of Wayground user data for training LLMs, and that its AI providers do not use Wayground data for model training: 'we have disabled their use of any Wayground user data for training their own large language models (LLMs), and our AI providers do not use our data to train their LLMs.' Separately, the help center states: 'OpenAI does not use any of your personal data for training its models,' and that Wayground AI 'solely uses the inputs teachers provide to generate content' without touching student personal data. No tier-based (free vs paid) distinction in this posture was found in current copy.
privacy.data_region: United States, AWS-hosted. Privacy policy: 'the service is hosted in the United States. The information we collect is hosted on servers located in the United States.' No EU/regional data residency option is documented publicly. DPAs are explicitly referenced for Canadian institutions/school districts; broader DPA availability for other regions is implied for institutional customers but not itemized.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Industry-standard encryption in transit using up-to-date certificates from a verified third-party provider (DigiCert).

security.name: Password storage
security.value: Passwords protected using the bcrypt password-hashing function.

security.name: Data center controls
security.value: Data stored in access-controlled data centers with 24/7 monitoring by AWS.

security.name: Accessibility compliance
security.value: Follows VPAT guidelines documenting compliance with Section 508 and WCAG; VPAT available upon request.

products.name: Wayground (formerly Quizizz) - core platform
products.data_scope: Student PII (email, first/last name, parent or guardian email in limited cases); accounts are optional for basic use.
products.notes: Primary teacher/student-facing product. Free teacher plan plus paid School & District plans. Covered by the FERPA/COPPA/GDPR posture and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification documented on wayground.com.

products.name: Wayground for Business
products.data_scope: Employee/learner data for corporate training programs.
products.notes: Quote-based enterprise sales ('Get a Quote'). No compliance posture separately documented from the core K-12 product; assume same corporate-level controls but unconfirmed.

products.name: Skillet (skillet.io)
products.notes: Linked from the Wayground for Business navigation as a separately branded product on its own domain (skillet.io), with its own privacy/security posture, not covered by Wayground's certifications.

products.name: Voyage Math (voyagemath.com)
products.notes: Separately branded sub-product on its own domain, linked from the Wayground nav as 'Math Practice New', with its own privacy/security posture separate from Wayground's.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free teacher plan) plus paid School & District plans and quote-based Business/Enterprise plans
compare.data_residency: US-hosted on AWS; no explicit EU/regional data residency option documented publicly

flags: SOC 2 status is unresolved: vendor operates a Drata-powered Trust Center (trust.quizizz.com) but it is access-gated (HTTP 403 to public/automated access), and no SOC 2 badge or descriptive text appears anywhere else on wayground.com.

Third-party aggregator/search-summary sources claim Quizizz/Wayground holds SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR certifications; none of these are corroborated on wayground.com or quizizz.com.

Legacy help-center copy (help.wayground.com, referencing the older support.quizizz.com article) still cites the defunct 'EU-U.S. Privacy Shield Framework' (invalidated 2020), which is inconsistent with the current, Privacy-Shield-free GDPR language on the privacy center page. This is stale legal copy the vendor should update.
PCI DSS applies only to Wayground's third-party payment provider, not to Quizizz Inc./Wayground itself.

No AI-governance certification (ISO/IEC 42001, CSA STAR) despite prominent AI-feature marketing (Wayground AI, multiple AI generators). Training-data posture is documented and favorable, but formal AI-governance certification is absent.

Brand identity: the product recently rebranded from 'Quizizz' to 'Wayground' (same legal entity, Quizizz Inc., DBA Wayground, same underlying domains and infrastructure). 'Wayground' is the current name; 'Quizizz' remains in use for search and legacy recognition. They are not different vendors.
